name: Trade war & tariffs
value: US proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners
summary: US proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners on 25 Nov, 20% on China and up to 15% on the EU; hearing on 25 Jan
state: On 25 Nov the US Trade Representative proposed excess-capacity tariffs on 14 trading partners under Section 301: up to 20% on China, rising to 40% if the truce expiring on 10 Jan fails, and a 15% cap for the EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Switzerland (Korea Times, Reuters). The tariffs would take effect only after a public hearing on 25 Jan (Global Trade & Sanctions Law). Nothing new is in force, so Watch holds.
for_you: Proposed US tariffs could raise costs for exporters and some imported goods next year. UK exporters can follow Department for Business and Trade guidance.
rubric_hit: New major tariffs proposed between large economies; none yet in force

sources.title: Korea Times (Reuters) — US proposes tariffs over excess production, retains 15% cap for Korea, Japan, EU
Global Trade & Sanctions Law — USTR proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies

why: Tariffs raise prices, reroute supply chains and slow growth; escalation cycles hurt export-heavy economies like the UK's partners.
drivers: US tariff policy, retaliation, court rulings, trade deals, WTO disputes.

rubric.alert: Broad new tariffs in force with retaliation under way, or US average effective tariff rising sharply.
rubric.watch: New major tariffs announced or threatened between large economies.
rubric.normal: Tariff regime stable; no new major measures in the past two weeks.
